subtext.hi: Area ratio = Square of side ratio!
subtext.en: Area ratio = Square of side ratio!

text.hi: Jab do triangles similar hote hain, unke areas ka ratio unke corresponding sides ke ratio ka square hota hai — board exams mein har saal aata hai.
text.en: When two triangles are similar, the ratio of their areas equals the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides — this appears in board exams every year.

content.hi: Area = ½×base×height. Similar triangles mein base aur height dono same ratio mein change hote hain, isliye area ratio = ratio×ratio = ratio².
content.en: Area = ½×base×height. In similar triangles, both base and height change by the same ratio, so area ratio = ratio×ratio = ratio².

content.hi: Ye sirf area ke liye nahi — altitude, median, aur perimeter bhi sides ke same ratio mein hote hain (sirf area square hota hai).
content.en: This isn't just for area — altitude, median, and perimeter also scale in the same ratio as the sides (only area is squared).

problem.en: ΔABC~ΔPQR, AB=6cm, PQ=4cm. Area(ΔABC)=81cm². Find Area(ΔPQR).

problem.hi: Do similar triangles ke areas 81cm² aur 49cm² hain. Bade ka altitude 13.5cm. Chhote ka altitude nikaalo.
problem.en: Two similar triangles have areas 81cm² and 49cm². The bigger's altitude is 13.5cm. Find the smaller's altitude.

question.hi: Do congruent triangles ke areas equal hote hain.
question.en: If two triangles are congruent, their areas are equal.

explanation.hi: Congruent = same shape+size, isliye area bhi same.
explanation.en: Congruent = same shape and size, so area is also the same.

question.en: Area(ABC)=100, Area(PQR)=64. Altitude from A=10cm. Find altitude from P.

notes.hi: Altitude/median bhi side ratio mein hote hain
notes.en: Altitude/median also scale in the side ratio

summary.hi: Area ratio hamesha side ratio ka square hota hai — is theorem se side/altitude/area kisi bhi 2 mein se 1 nikaal sakte ho.
summary.en: Area ratio is always the square of side ratio — this theorem lets you find any one of side/altitude/area given the other.
